title: Vikunja
database: sqlite3 (/tmp/vikunja.db inside the vikunja-data named volume)

notes: keep_regex ^/api/v2/ is the API the 2.x web UI calls; the legacy /api/v1 (PUT creates, POST updates) still answers but the UI never uses it (the seed does)
auth=29 are the login and the UI's token refreshes (POST /api/v2/user/token/refresh) on every page load
service workers were blocked in the browser context: Vikunja's PWA worker otherwise records each page fetch twice

manifest_vs_norules.note: Vikunja ids are integers, which rea templates with its built-in numeric rule in both views, so the opt-in rules change nothing (28 tools either way). Two-id routes get `id` and `id_2` parameters.

seeded_objects: 4 users (rea-admin and three crew members), 5 projects (one child, one archived), 3 labels, 7 tasks with priorities, due dates, labels, assignees and a relation, 2 comments, 2 teams, project shares to the teams and one user, and 1 saved filter

seeded_objects_detail.scratch_during_capture: task Rea scratch task created (POST 201), edited (PATCH 200), read, deleted (DELETE 204), re-read (404)

auth_note: The 2.x web UI signs in with POST /api/v2/login, keeps the JWT in localStorage ("token"), sends it as a bearer header and refreshes it through POST /api/v2/user/token/refresh. The scripted fetch calls read the token from localStorage inside the page. Login and refresh are dropped by the scope's auth filter; request headers are stripped.
